create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-plain-pick-and-place.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing for plain single-object placement

Traces t1, t4, t6. Tasks: salt shaker into drawer, salt shaker on black table, move watch from drawer to coffee table. Ground truth was pick_and_place. No skill was loaded.

Cue: one object, a move/put verb, a destination, and no state change (heat, cool, clean) and no count. Load pick_and_place. Verbs like 'move' count too.

create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-two-object-placement.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing when task has two objects

Traces t5, t7, t8. Tasks: two spray bottles on a cabinet, alarm clocks moved to a shelf, two shakers on the end table. Ground truth was pick_two_obj_and_place. No skill was loaded.

Cue: 'two', or a plural noun that implies two (alarm clocks), with a destination. Load pick_two_obj_and_place, not pick_and_place. The plural alone can be the only cue.

create_patterns.name: selection-loaded-nothing-for-heat-or-clean-transform.md
create_patterns.content:
# Loaded nothing when a state change is requested

Traces t2, t3. 'Heat a tomato and place it' needed pick_heat_then_place. 'Place a rinsed knife on a counter' needed pick_clean_then_place. No skill was loaded.

Cue: heat or clean words, including indirect ones such as 'rinsed', mean the transform skill. Match the implied state change to the skill, not plain pick_and_place. Cooling maps to pick_cool_then_place the same way.
